review_improvement: Prevents a wrong-workload repository from being executed and converts the title-only procedure into an explicit owner-supplied BERT99 evidence contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: BERT score depends on sequence distribution, precision, batching and scenario; Server and Offline results are not interchangeable. A Llama repository represents different model architecture, tokenizer/data and memory behavior, so it cannot serve as evidence for BERT merely because both use MLPerf. Accuracy and LoadGen validity must accompany any performance score.
